items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: there was, a guy had a trio called -- Lorenzo Flournoy Flinney had a trio, and Nellie Letcher had her trio... So they brought 5 or 6 musicians... and we would close it, you know.

ctx.x: You know? There was a band on recording, so anyway -- they heard about us back east. But to tell you more about Billy Berg's, I used to give jam sessions there every Sunday. Now, I would call the musicians. What would happen, well -- I was fined once $500 because in Los Angeles, they did not want you to jam, you know, and as I stated earlier, I always carried my drums around with me, and wherever someone was playing, I would play, you know, and I

lived next door to the Union, you know, and -- I lived at 1706 Central -- and 1710 was the Musicians Union. And I was before the Board every time the Board would meet, because I wouldn't stop jamming. And they said they were gonna fine me, you know, but I mean, I was like an adopted child of theirs that was bad and was gonna keep doing it.
